name: Energy Field
description: A site's own generation and storage: PV blocks (string inverters), small wind turbines, one battery array, the site's consumption. Simulated from the weather forecast; the battery array dispatched by the mode (Auto - rules on the grid prices, Manual, Island); the site's balance on the grid meter. Commands, WEM, time series, AI tool energy.field. Depends on weather-control and energy-grid.
